en.headline: Senior secondary science and maths curriculum to be revamped from 2029-30
en.dek: The Education Bureau will update physics, chemistry, biology and extended mathematics syllabuses to encourage more students to take multiple science subjects.
body: Hong Kong’s Education Bureau has announced plans to revamp the senior secondary science and extended mathematics curriculum starting from the 2029-30 academic year, aiming to attract more students and nurture innovation and technology talent.

In a circular issued to schools on Monday, the bureau said the update aligns with the national strategy to invigorate the country through science and education and supports Hong Kong’s development as an international innovation and technology centre.

Drafts of the updated curriculum and assessment frameworks for physics, chemistry and biology have been released for consultation. The bureau will brief educators early next month before finalising the documents in the next academic year. The revised science subjects will apply to the 2032 Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education Examination and beyond.

Schools are encouraged to actively promote students interested in science and mathematics to take two or more science subjects, and to consider placing such students in the same class to create synergistic learning effects.

zh.headline: 高中數理課程2029/30學年起優化
zh.dek: 教育局將更新物理、化學、生物及數學延伸部分課程，鼓勵更多學生修讀多個理科科目。
body: 教育局公布，高中科學及數學延伸部分課程將於2029/30學年起優化，目標是吸引更多學生修讀數理科目，培育創科人才。
局方周一發出通函予學校，指更新措施配合國家「科教興國」策略，並支持香港發展成為國際創科中心。
物理、化學及生物科的更新課程與評核架構諮詢稿已經發布。局方下月初會向教育界簡介，並於下學年敲定文件。更新後的科學科將適用於2032年及以後的香港中學文憑考試。
局方鼓勵學校積極推動對數理有興趣的學生同時修讀兩個或以上科學科目，並考慮將這些學生編入同一班別，以加強學習協同效應。
